frame_check.convention: LPS mm; NIfTI affine is RAS: negate x,y before inv(affine)

mask_edit.reference_impl: mask_edit.json reference_implementation, executed verbatim (only a MASK_NII line is prepended)
mask_edit.erosion_definition_note: the packages give a shipped erosion count (25 truncation-only, 40 with the branch) but not its definition. Measured here: removed voxels whose nearest retained centreline point is at distance <= f x r_mm (protect ball is 1.10 r, so f<=1.10 is 0 by construction).

parent_radius_change.method: Euclidean distance transform (voxel spacing 0.318x0.318x0.5 mm) of the left-tree component, sampled at the centreline nodes, edited minus unedited mask

surface.marching_cubes: skimage.measure.marching_cubes level 0.5 on the isolated left-tree component (voxel-index vertices -> affine -> LPS mm)
surface.taubin: vmtksurfacesmoothing -iterations 30 -passband 0.1 (identical to the 837 recipe; reproduces 837's smoothed.vtp exactly)

RELATIVE_GATE.rule: |as-built/undeformed (same section, same definition) / radial_scale - 1| <= 1 % for all three definitions

LITERAL_ABSOLUTE_vs_r_target.rule: as-built radius vs r_target_mm (work order text); reported, NOT decisive (see module docstring)

extensions.rule: CFD-ARM-SPEC 6.2: 5 D at the inlet, 3 D at each outlet; D = 2 r_mm of the package (inlet.json / outlets.csv); straight planar extrusion of the clipped loop along the package plane normal, planar fan cap (837 rebuild_surface method; no vmtksurfaceremeshing)

probe_s_offset.note: package s_mm = arc from the inlet node - offset_mm on the root->LAD path

surface_radius_csv.columns_note: s_mm = arc from the inlet node along the centreline tree; s_pkg_mm = the package's probe s (arc - offset) on the root->LAD path only; x/y/z = the section origin (path frame point for the LAD path, node otherwise)
surface_radius_csv.definition: surface-based (not the mesh): planar section of the final wall surface normal to the path tangent at each centreline node; r_eq3D = area-equivalent radius, r_max_inscribed = 2-D maximum inscribed circle of the section; section_ok = centroid within 0.5 r_eq of the node, closed loop, area within 0.6..1.6 of the parent node's; the mesh-based version comes after meshing
